summary: Insert shot (extreme close-up) of the horse character's belly and hips. A locked-off camera looks slightly up at a giant champagne-gold extruded 'A' belt buckle on a black croc-leather belt. Two huge brown fur fists grip the belt on either side of the buckle. Gold rings are on both fists and a gold watch is on the character's left wrist. He wears a purple 70s suit jacket, a rust-red shirt with navy dots and navy pants. The camera never moves. All motion comes from the character's groove. The hips dip on every beat (lowest at about 1.600, 2.067 and 2.533; beats fall at 1.626, 2.114 and 2.602). They also roll the opposite way on each beat (+7 deg, then -4 deg, then +5.5 deg) and sway sideways about 0.33 studs, one full sway every 2 beats. The fists stay locked to the belt and ride along. From 1.90 to 2.23 a warm glint flares at the apex of the A. It peaks around 2.03-2.13, on beat 4: the whole buckle face whitens, a round warm bloom sits on the tip, and orange light spills onto the shirt and onto the belt seen through the A's hole. The subtitle 'DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO' stays on screen the whole time. Hard cut in at 1.433 (from S01, the man with sunglasses) and hard cut out at 2.700 (to S03, the trio, with the subtitle 'THE AURA FARMER'). The last frame of this shot is 2.667. The source is 25 fps inside a 30 fps file, so every 5th frame is a duplicate.

camera.framing: Extreme close-up / insert on the belt buckle. Top edge: mid-belly, where the shirt V and the red collar points sit with a little dark neck fur at top-center. Bottom edge: crotch and upper thighs in navy pants. Left and right edges: just past each wrist. The black cuff on the character's right wrist touches the left edge; the gold watch on the left wrist sits about 92% across. The A buckle is near center, its base center moving between 43% and 54% of frame width. It fills about 31% of frame width (about 266 px of 854) and about 65% of frame height (apex at y=45-95, base at y=330-420 of 480). The character's right fist (screen-left) fills x 0-38%. His left fist (screen-right) fills x 60-97%. Purple jacket panels fill the top corners (lapels and sleeves) and the bottom corners (jacket hem beside the hips). Background shows through only in small gaps: a pier at screen-right (x 720-854, y 300-420) and beach and a far structure at screen-left (x 0-90, y 320-480). At the subject plane the visible area is about 2.9 studs wide by 1.6 studs tall (about 0.0033 studs per pixel at 854x480).
camera.position: Straight in front of the character on his centerline. Yaw 0, square to the buckle; the character faces the camera directly. The lens is about 2.5 studs in front of the buckle's front face, at about 2.75 studs above the ground. That is about 0.45 studs below the buckle center, which is about 3.2 studs above the ground for a 5.5-stud character (belt line at the LowerTorso). The frame top cuts at about 4.0 studs (mid-belly) and the bottom at about 2.4 studs (upper thigh). Aim the camera at the buckle center.
camera.angle: Low angle looking up. Pitch about +10 deg up: the sea horizon and pier legs sit at y=385-395 of 480, about 81% down the frame. Yaw 0. Roll 0: horizon and pier deck stay level, no dutch angle. Because the camera is below the buckle, the underside bevel of each leg of the A shows as a thin bright gold strip.
camera.lensNotes: Normal lens, about 40 mm full-frame equivalent, with no visible barrel distortion. Focus is on the buckle and fists at about 2.5 studs. Depth of field is moderately shallow. The pier and beach, about 60-100 studs behind, are clearly soft (blur radius about 3-4 px at 854 wide) but still recognisable. The jacket edges at the top corners are slightly soft. Shutter-style motion blur smears the fur and ring edges on the fast dips (1.567-1.633, 1.933-2.067, 2.400-2.467). Soft bloom halos sit where the blown-out sky meets the sleeves and fur. Frame cadence is 25 fps content in a 30 fps container (duplicate frames at 1.500, 1.667, 1.833, 2.000, 2.167, 2.333, 2.500, 2.667).

movement.description: Hard cut in. Locked-off static camera: no pan, tilt, dolly or zoom. The buckle's width stays constant at about 260-266 px for the whole shot, and the pier deck in the background holds at y=315-347 and a fixed x (within 1-3 px). All apparent framing changes come from the character moving.
Still static through the glint. The buckle drifts left of center (base center x=364) only because the character's hips sway to his right.
Last frame, still static. Hard cut at 2.700 to the S03 trio wide shot.

camera.shake: None. Tripod-locked: no handheld shake, whip or zoom. If anything, add at most 0.05 deg of slow random drift. The character's hip motion supplies the energy.

subjects.who: Horse character in a purple suit (only the belly, hips, belt, forearm ends and both hands are in frame; the head is out of frame above)
subjects.appearance: FUR: dense, soft brown fur about 0.05-0.08 studs long, with flyaway backlit hairs on the outlines. Mid tone #72503E, lit #8B5E47, warm rim highlight #C7A58C, shadow #3B2720 / #2F2120, deepest #1A1312. A bit of darker neck/chest fur (#3A2418) shows in the shirt V at the top-center edge. HANDS: oversized mitten-like fur fists, each about 0.9 studs wide, 0.85 tall and 0.6 deep (about as wide as the buckle). No visible claws or hooves; faint finger creases (3 grooves) show on the backs of the curled fingers. SUIT JACKET: 70s cut with very wide lapels and wide sleeves, purple-violet with a satin/velvet sheen. Highlight #8070B0 (reads as lavender, about #8C7FD0), mid #3E3A7E, shadow #212660, deep #171E53. Worn open: the lapels frame the shirt at the top and the front panels hang down beside the hips to the bottom corners. The character's left sleeve ends right above the watch. On the character's right wrist (screen-left edge) a black / very dark navy cuff band (#101420), about 0.08 studs wide, shows between sleeve and fur. SHIRT: rust red #72332E (lit #8B3A30, shadow #461C1B) with small oval navy/indigo dots #383971, each about 0.025 studs, spaced about 0.1 studs in a staggered grid. Big pointed 70s collar, open at the neck. BELT: about 0.3 studs tall, black textured croc/snake-scale leather (#1B1A1F, highlights #504C45), with a faint lighter stitch line along the top edge. BUCKLE: giant extruded capital 'A', a sans-serif with a sharp pointed apex. About 0.9 studs wide at the base, about 1.05 studs tall and about 0.12 studs thick. Each leg is about 0.28 studs wide at the bottom, with a 0.36-stud gap between the legs at the bottom. The crossbar is solid from 0.21 to 0.40 studs above the base. Above it is a small triangular hole, about 0.2 wide and 0.28 tall (0.40-0.68 above base). The front face is brushed champagne gold that runs darker at the top and lighter at the bottom (#7A7467, then #C9BEA6 at mid, #D1C5AB lower). The bevels and side faces are saturated gold #C39D5E with highlight #E0B860. The buckle sits in front of the belt and overlaps the inner edges of both fists. Its apex rises about 0.5 studs above the belt top onto the shirt, and its base hangs about 0.15 studs below the belt onto the pants. PANTS: dark navy #161B2E (highlight #262A3F) with a fine ribbed, slightly scaly weave. RINGS: on the character's right fist (screen-left), on a finger at the lower inner knuckle near the A's left leg, a large oval signet about 0.12 studs across: gold band #C39D5E, flat black onyx face #1F1713 reflecting grey sky #746854. On the character's left fist (screen-right), on a finger at the lower inner knuckle, a round signet about 0.13 studs across: copper/rose-gold face #7C412A with highlight #B0703F and a faint engraved emblem, gold rim #C8A060. Beside it, on the next finger toward the pinky, a thin plain gold band #C39D5E. WATCH: on the character's left wrist (screen top-right of that fist), a gold Rolex-style watch with a gold link bracelet #A78358 and a cream/white dial #D4C5CC, about 0.25 studs wide. BODY: a large mascot-like build with a broad belly and hips; the hips are about 2 studs wide.
subjects.placement: Centered in frame and facing the camera squarely, with the body front pointing at the lens and no yaw. The buckle sits on the frame's vertical center line: base center at x=364-463 of 854, belt band at y=190-290 of 480. The character's RIGHT fist is on screen-LEFT, gripping the belt about 0.65 studs to the right of the buckle center; its forearm enters from the left edge, sloping down and inward at about 30 deg below horizontal. The character's LEFT fist is on screen-RIGHT, about 0.65 studs to the left of the buckle center; its forearm enters from the right edge at about 30 deg. The wrists are about 1.2-1.3 studs either side of the midline, about 0.3 studs higher than the fists.

poseKeys.body: PELVIS / LowerTorso (relative to neutral, where neutral is the buckle on the camera axis at its highest point in the shot): X +0.12 studs toward the character's LEFT (screen-right; base center x=463); Y -0.08 (dropping); Z 0. Roll +5 deg, where positive means the character's RIGHT hip is lower and LEFT hip higher, so the buckle top leans to screen-left (bottom edge on the character's left side about 18 px higher than on his right). Yaw 0, pitch 0. Moving toward the character's right at about 0.5 studs/s and downward. WAIST / UpperTorso: counter-roll -4 deg so the chest stays almost level (net chest roll +1 deg); chest offset only +0.04 studs toward the character's left. RIGHT ARM: shoulder abducted 32 deg, extended back 15 deg, internally rotated 35 deg; elbow flexed 95 deg; wrist flexed toward the palm 45 deg with 15 deg ulnar deviation, forearm pronated so the knuckles face the camera. LEFT ARM: mirrored; shoulder abducted 28 deg, back 15 deg, internal rotation 35 deg; elbow 92 deg; wrist flexion 45 deg. HANDS: both are tight fists around the belt. Four fingers curl over the front of the belt (MCP about 80 deg, PIP 90 deg, DIP 60 deg) with fingertips tucked just below the belt's lower edge. Thumbs are hooked behind the belt inside the waistband, hidden. Right fist ring at screen (258,315); left fist ring at (675,335). LEGS (off-frame): weight moving from the left leg to the right; both knees about 12 deg.
poseKeys.face: Not in frame (head above the top edge). No mouth or eyes visible. For continuity, a cool, confident look with the head bobbing down on each beat.

poseKeys.body: BEAT 3 DIP (beat at 1.626; the bottom lands 1 frame early). PELVIS: X 0.06 toward the character's RIGHT (base center x=410); Y -0.24 studs, the lowest point of this bounce; roll +7.4 deg, the maximum of the shot, with the right hip down and left hip up. Yaw 0. WAIST: counter-roll -6 deg; chest dips only about 0.10 studs (about 40% of the pelvis dip). ARMS: hands drop with the belt, so both elbows open to about 100 deg and shoulders extend back about 18 deg; wrists flex 50 deg as if pressing the belt down. The character's right fist is lower relative to the buckle than the left, following the roll. HANDS: the grip squeezes, with fingers curled 5 deg tighter. Slight motion blur on the fur. LEGS: knees bent about 22 deg, weight on the left leg (left knee straighter, about 16 deg; right knee about 26 deg).

TOP OF BOUNCE between beats. PELVIS: X 0.19 toward the character's RIGHT (base center x=368); Y 0, the highest point in the shot; roll 0 (level). Yaw 0. WAIST: counter-roll 0, chest centered about 0.06 studs to the character's right. RIGHT ARM: the hand has moved outward, so shoulder abduction rises to 35 deg and the elbow opens to 92 deg. LEFT ARM: the hand has moved toward the midline, so shoulder abduction drops to 24 deg and the elbow flexes to 98 deg. Wrists flex 45 deg. HANDS: firm fists; right ring at about (175,285), left ring at about (575,330). The buckle face is at its darkest here (upper face about #63614F) because its tilt reflects the dark belly. LEGS: knees about 8 deg, nearly straight.

SIDE-SWAY EXTREME toward the character's RIGHT; the glint starts. PELVIS: X 0.21 toward the character's RIGHT (base center x=364, about 0.33 studs from the start position); Y -0.09 and dropping again; roll -3 deg and rolling the other way, so the character's LEFT hip starts to drop and the buckle top leans to screen-right. WAIST: counter-roll +2.5 deg; the chest tilts about 1 deg toward the character's left. ARMS: the same as 1.867 with a quick wrist snap of about 5 deg extra flexion (a small tug, motion-blurred) as if the tug tips the buckle into the sun. The right fist rides about 0.08 studs higher than the left relative to the belt. LEGS: weight shifting onto the right leg.

BEAT 4 DIP (beat at 2.114; the bottom lands about 1.5 frames early) while the glint peaks. PELVIS: X 0.17 toward the character's RIGHT (base center x=374); Y -0.20 studs, the lowest point of this bounce; roll -3.7 deg, the CW maximum, with the LEFT hip down and right hip up. This is contrapposto with the weight on the right leg. WAIST: counter-roll +3 deg; chest dips about 0.08. ARMS: elbows open to about 100 deg and wrists flex 50 deg, pressing the belt down; the left fist is now about 0.08 studs lower than the right (left ring at about (570,410), right ring at about (162,325)). The fingers squeeze. LEGS: right knee about 14 deg, carrying the weight; left knee about 26 deg, relaxed.

TOP OF BOUNCE. PELVIS: X 0.06 toward the character's RIGHT (base center x=409), travelling back toward his left; Y -0.05 (high); roll 0 (level). WAIST: neutral. ARMS: back to the baseline (shoulder abduction about 30 deg each, elbows 95 deg, wrists 45 deg). HANDS: right ring at about (210,310), left ring at about (600,355). Glint gone; the buckle face returns to its normal shading (upper face about #74715F). LEGS: knees about 8 deg.

SIDE-SWAY EXTREME toward the character's LEFT (a smaller swing). PELVIS: X 0.00, back on the camera axis (base center x=428); Y -0.23 and falling fast; roll +5.2 deg, with the RIGHT hip dropping again. Motion blur on the fur. WAIST: counter-roll -4 deg. RIGHT ARM: the hand has moved toward the midline, so shoulder abduction is about 27 deg and the elbow about 98 deg. LEFT ARM: the hand has moved outward, so shoulder abduction is about 33 deg and the elbow about 93 deg. Wrists flex 48 deg. LEGS: weight onto the left leg.

BEAT 5 DIP (beat at 2.602; the bottom lands about 2 frames early). PELVIS: X 0.02 toward the character's RIGHT (base center x=420); Y -0.30 studs, the LOWEST point of the shot; roll +5.5 deg, with the right hip down and left hip up, weight on the left leg. WAIST: counter-roll -5 deg; chest dips about 0.12. ARMS: elbows open to about 102 deg; wrists flex 50 deg, pressing down; right ring at about (225,405), left ring at about (635,405). The buckle face brightens as it reflects the sunlit sand (upper face about #BBB39E). LEGS: left knee about 18 deg (weight), right knee about 28 deg.

LAST FRAME before the cut. PELVIS: X 0.06 toward the character's RIGHT (base center x=408); Y -0.13 and rising; roll +4.8 deg. The motion carries on past the cut, rising toward a top at about 2.75. ARMS: easing back toward the baseline (elbows 96 deg, wrists 45 deg). HANDS: right ring at about (222,350), left ring at about (613,352).

subjects.motionNotes: Groove on the 123 BPM grid (beat 0.4878 s). VERTICAL: one hip dip per beat; the bottoms at 1.600, 2.067 and 2.533 land on beats 1.626, 2.114 and 2.602, 1-2 frames early. Peak-to-peak amplitude is 0.20-0.30 studs (screen base y: 401 low, 329 high, 391 low, 345 high, 419 low). Drop into each dip with ease-in (quad), so it accelerates down and hits the beat hard. Rise out of it with ease-out (quad), floating up to the top at the off-beat (1.867, 2.267). ROLL: alternates each beat in sync with the dips: +7.4 deg (right hip down) at beat 3, -3.7 deg (left hip down) at beat 4, +5.5 deg at beat 5; the roll crosses 0 at 1.867 and 2.25. Treat it as a sine-like curve with a 2-beat period whose extremes coincide with the dips. LATERAL SWAY: X slides from +0.12 (character's left) at 1.433 to 0.21 to the right at 1.933 (extreme), then back to 0.00 at 2.433 (extreme), then 0.06 right at 2.667. That is a 2-beat period with smooth sine easing; the sway extremes fall about a quarter-beat after the dips (1.93, 2.43). The chest stays almost still: motion is about 30% of the pelvis laterally and about 40% vertically, with counter-roll at the waist, so the movement reads as a hip wiggle under a stable torso. The hands are rigidly locked to the belt (use IK to belt attachments); they only add a tiny squeeze and press-down on each dip and a small wrist snap at 1.93 that motivates the glint. There is no pelvis yaw or forward thrust (the buckle never changes size). SECONDARY: fur tips lag the fists by about 2 frames and settle with a small overshoot after each dip. The jacket front panels at the bottom corners swing about 0.03 studs, lagging the hip sway by about 3 frames. The buckle is rigid metal; its highlight shifts with the roll (bright when tipped down on the dips, dark at the 1.77-1.87 top). Visible motion blur on the fastest frames (1.567-1.633, 1.933-2.067, 2.400-2.467).

set: Sunny British-style seaside beach, almost entirely blocked by the character's body; the background only shows at the edges. GROUND: pale pinkish-beige sand (#C0AD9F / #CEBBAD), visible at bottom-left (x 0-100, y 380-480), flat and wide. SCREEN-RIGHT BACKGROUND: a Victorian pleasure pier running away to the right. Its deck is a dark green-black horizontal band (#162422) sitting at y=315-347 (just above the horizon), on rows of pale grey cast-iron legs (#BFC4C8) down to the sea and horizon at y=385-400. Place it about 60-90 studs behind the character and 15-30 studs to the camera's right, deck about 8-10 studs above the sand, legs about 0.6 studs thick every 6 studs. SCREEN-LEFT BACKGROUND (only visible 1.433-1.6, before the sleeve covers it): a distant low structure or second pier pavilion with a dark green roof at y=320-365, about 100 studs away. SEA: pale grey-blue (#A9B6C2), mostly blown out near the horizon. SKY: hazy, overexposed pale blue-white, #E7E5E6 near the subject's silhouette to #B1C0CB in the upper corners; no visible clouds. No other props: the giant 'A' buckle, belt, rings and watch belong to the character.
lighting: Bright midday-to-afternoon sun through haze. Overall exposure is bright, the sky is clipped, contrast is medium, colors are fairly saturated (purple and red pop) and blacks are slightly lifted. KEY: a high sun about 55-60 deg up, behind the character and a little to screen-left. It gives strong warm rim light (#FFE8D0) along the top edges of both fur fists, the tops of the sleeves and the lapel edges; backlit fur hairs glow #C7A58C. FILL: large and soft from the front and below, from the bright sand and sky behind the camera. It lights the fronts of the fists, the buckle face and the shirt fairly evenly at about 1.5 stops under the rim. Fill is neutral to slightly warm, about 5500 K; the sky is about 7000 K. SHADOWS: deep where the forms turn away. The belt (#1B1A1F), the pants (#0C0F20 to #161B2E) and the fur under the fists (#1A1312) carry the darkest values. METAL: the buckle face acts as a brushed mirror. It is brighter on its lower half (it reflects the sand, about #D1C5AB) and darker on its upper half (it reflects the dark belly, about #7A7467). Its brightness follows the hip roll: darkest at 1.77-1.87 (upper face #63614F), brightest on the dips (2.53: #BBB39E), and whitened by the glint at 1.93-2.2 (#EFE9D9). The underside bevels glow saturated gold (#C39D5E to #E0B860) because they face the bright sand. BLOOM: soft halos where the bright sky meets the sleeves and fur at the top corners and the right edge. No natural lens flare; the only flare is the glint effect.

effects.description: Hard cut in from S01 (close-up of the man with sunglasses). There is no transition effect; the subtitle carries over unchanged.
Light motion blur on the fur fists and rings during the beat-3 dip (to 1.633).

GLINT BUILD-UP: a warm orange-yellow glow (#F0A020, edges #D28411) appears on the shirt just above the belt, immediately screen-left of the A's left leg (the character's right side). It is a patch about 0.25 x 0.12 studs. A faint warm haze forms near the apex.

GLINT HIT: a bright specular streak runs along the upper-left (screen-left) stroke of the A, from the apex about 0.25 studs down the edge. A blown-out bloom (core #FFF6E6, halo #FFB050 fading to #B6512E) bursts at the apex tip, about 0.12 studs across, with a soft smear up and to the left. The upper buckle face jumps from #63614F to about #D5C6AE.

GLINT PEAK (holds until 2.133, centered on beat 4 at 2.114). The round bloom on the apex grows to about 0.2 studs across, with a soft halo out to about 0.4 studs. A faint vertical glow spike rises from the tip into the shirt V up to the top edge. The entire front face of the A is whitened (#E7E1CF to #EFE9D9). Warm light spills onto the belt visible through the A's triangular hole, turning it bronze-gold (#CAA57D) with visible snake-scale texture. The orange glow on the shirt beside the left leg is at full strength (#F0A020). The glint tracks the apex as the hips move.
Motion blur on the fists during the beat-4 dip, with the glint still at peak.

GLINT DECAY: bloom smaller and dimmer; the face starts returning to normal. At 2.233 everything is gone: no bloom, normal buckle shading, no orange spill. Total glint about 0.30 s with a fast attack (1 frame) and a 2-3 frame release.
Motion blur on the fur during the beat-5 dip (to 2.467). The buckle brightens naturally as it tips down to reflect the sand; this is not a glint.
Hard cut out to S03 (wide shot of the trio on the beach). On the cut the subtitle changes to 'THE AURA FARMER'.

subtitle: 'DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO' (eight 'DO's) is on screen for the whole shot (1.433-2.667). It is already present in S01 before the cut and does not change at 1.433. It changes to 'THE AURA FARMER' exactly at the cut to the next shot (2.700). STYLE: heavy bold italic sans-serif (a Gotham Black Italic look) in all caps. Each letter's fill runs yellow at the top (#FFD84A / #F0CB4F) to orange at the bottom (#F0AD2C to #F28C1E). A red (#D8241C) 3D extrusion of about 2-3 px drops down and right, and a thin dark maroon outer edge and shadow (#270B17) follows that. Position: horizontally centered (x 238-618 of 854, center 50%), vertical center y=443 of 480 (92.3% down). Cap height about 22-24 px (about 4.8% of frame height); the line spans about 44% of frame width. Spaces equal about 0.35 of a cap width. The text is static: no pop, bounce or color change.
recreateInRoblox:
CAMERA: camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable; camera.FieldOfView = 34. With the buckle center at B = (0, 3.2, 0) and the character facing -Z toward the camera: camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(B + Vector3.new(0, -0.45, -2.5), B). That gives a 10 deg upward pitch, no roll and a static camera. Do not animate the camera. Render at 16:9; for best quality use graphics level 10 and capture at 60 fps, then conform to 30 or 25 fps.

CHARACTER: a custom R15 horse rig at 5.5-stud scale with LowerTorso at about 3.1 studs. Replace the hands with oversized fur MeshParts (about 0.9 x 0.85 x 0.6 studs, closed-fist shape). Use SurfaceAppearance with a fur ColorMap (#72503E base, #8B5E47 lit, darker roots) plus a strand NormalMap. For the fuzzy silhouette, add a second shell mesh 3% larger with a fur alpha texture (AlphaMode Transparency) and a few thin backlit hair cards on the top edges. Jacket: MeshPart with wide lapels and open front, Fabric material, Color #4C46A8, plus SurfaceAppearance with a satin sheen (Roughness about 0.45) so highlights reach about #8C7FD0. Shirt: Color #7A3028 with a tiled Decal or Texture of navy #383971 ovals (about 0.025-stud dots at 0.1-stud spacing) and a big pointed collar. Pants: #161B2E Fabric with a fine rib texture. Belt: a band of Parts or a MeshPart 0.3 tall around the LowerTorso, Color #1B1A1F, with a croc/snake-scale normal map (Roughness 0.4) and a thin grey stitch line along the top.

BUCKLE: model the 'A' in Blender (0.9 wide, 1.05 tall, 0.12 deep, 0.01 bevel, small triangular counter 0.4-0.68 above the base, crossbar 0.21-0.40) and import it as a MeshPart. Give it SurfaceAppearance with Metalness 1, Roughness 0.25, Color #D2C3A0, and make the bevels slightly more saturated (#C9A050). Quick fallback: two leg Parts 0.28 x 1.12 x 0.12 rotated about +/-23 deg plus a crossbar Part 0.45 x 0.19 x 0.12, unioned, with Material Foil, Color #CDBF9A, Reflectance 0.2. Weld it 0.06 in front of the belt, centered, apex 0.5 above the belt top. RINGS: a gold torus MeshPart (#C39D5E, Metal). The character's right-hand ring takes an oval Cylinder face in Glass or SmoothPlastic #1F1713 with Reflectance 0.35. The left-hand ring takes a round face of #7C412A Metal, plus a thin gold band on the next finger. WATCH: a gold Cylinder case with a #D4C5CC dial and a gold link-bracelet mesh on the character's left wrist.

LIGHTING: Lighting.Technology = Future; Brightness 3.5; ClockTime about 14.5. Set GeographicLatitude so the sun sits behind and above the character, slightly to screen-left (rotate the whole set if needed). EnvironmentDiffuseScale 1, EnvironmentSpecularScale 1 (vital for the gold reflections). OutdoorAmbient (140,140,154); Ambient (60,56,70); ExposureCompensation +0.4. Atmosphere: Density 0.32, Offset 0.1, Color #C7D0DA, Decay #9AA6B8, Glare 0.4, Haze 2.2, with a pale hazy Sky. Front fill: an invisible part about 1.5 studs behind the camera holding a SurfaceLight facing the character (Color #FFF2E0, Brightness 1.5, Range 8, Angle 90). Rim: a SpotLight about 3 studs behind and 3 above the fists aimed at them (Color #FFE8D0, Brightness 4, Range 8, Angle 70, Shadows on). Post effects: BloomEffect Intensity 0.7, Size 28, Threshold 1.5. ColorCorrectionEffect Brightness 0.03, Contrast 0.12, Saturation 0.18, TintColor (255,248,240). DepthOfFieldEffect FocusDistance 2.5, InFocusRadius 0.8, FarIntensity 0.45, NearIntensity 0.15. SunRaysEffect Intensity 0.04.

SET: a flat sand Baseplate (#C0AD9F, Sand material). A pier 60-90 studs back and 15-30 studs to the right: a deck of dark Parts (#162422) at 8-10 studs height on Cylinder legs (#BFC4C8) every 6 studs. Far water plane #A9B6C2, and a distant low dark-green-roofed block on the left about 100 studs out.

ANIMATION (Animation Editor or Moon Animator 2, 30 fps, keys at the times in poseKeys): animate the Root/LowerTorso offset and roll only. Y: 0 / -0.24 / 0 / -0.20 / -0.05 / -0.30 at 1.600 / 1.867 / 2.067 / 2.267 / 2.533 (start -0.08 at 1.433, end -0.13 at 2.667). Ease In Quad into each low and Ease Out Quad out of it.
